requirements.requirement: Canonical JSON is deterministic across Rust, TypeScript and Python
Canonical SHA-256 is identical across languages
Opaque canonical entity/event/evidence/run IDs cannot be confused with provider IDs
Source identity semantics must converge on CP02 SourceIdentityKey namespace and normalization policy
Temporal values require explicit timezone and preserve valid-time versus recorded-time semantics
Epistemic and authority classes remain distinct
Confidence is finite and bounded to [0,1]
EventEnvelope is versioned, tenant/scope bound and hashable
Schema accept/reject behavior has Rust/TS/Python parity
Critical coverage, changed-line coverage and mutation kill meet G1
No secret or tenant/scope leakage in fixtures/contracts
CI actions are immutable-SHA pinned before G1 promotion

promotion_rule: No requirement with OPEN_GAP, NOT_STARTED, NOT_YET_CERTIFIED or *_REQUIRED may remain at G1 PASS.
